title: Feedbacks at ethIndia, we call it ethFeeds!
tagline: Stores feedbacks from folks about ethIndia. To make it more user onboarding we have used account abstraction to eliminate wallets and provided sponsored transactions to make everything go in a click.
description:
The advantages of blockchain are endless like secure data, publicly visible ledger, low cross border payments value. But sometimes or the other blockchain does require a wallet or some crypto payments to be made for the user to interact it with,  that is a little onboarding for non web3 folks. So we keeping this in mind we have used account abstraction to create smart contract wallet so the user doesnt have to have a wallet. Also, we have sponsored our transactions for now for users to submit feedback on chain with just a click using biconomy SDK.
We have different roles to segregate feedback posts and ordered by block number and retrived from polygon mumbai blockchain using ethers library.
Smart contract was written in solidity and deployed and verified to polygon mumbai.

**Links**
- [https://github.com/BelugaWhaleSam/ethFeeds](https://github.com/BelugaWhaleSam/ethFeeds)
how_its_made: Initially we werent able to run it on react on the first run due to dependency issues, so we tried making the biconomy rest api for that to POST the data on chain by pinging API, but we resolved this issue and did everything in react at the end.
